args.summary: The v2.3.1 deployment of checkout-api caused widespread health check failures with an elevated error rate of 18%. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed in us-east (orchestrator error), so the rollback was re-executed and completed successfully across all regions. Service is now healthy with error rate reduced to 0.2%.

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api (v2.3.1) was unhealthy across all regions with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent version healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: First rollback attempt partially failed after completing us-east, so I re-ran the rollback, which successfully deployed v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery**: Service is now healthy with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: **INC-0001** (SEV2) created, detailing the bad v2.3.1 deploy, the partial rollback failure, the completed rollback to v2.3.0, and recovery. On-call has been paged.
